result:
When tossing 3 coins, you can get any number of heads from 0 to 3. Specifically, the possible outcomes are:

*   **0 heads** (all tails)
*   **1 head**
*   **2 heads**
*   **3 heads** (all heads)

If you are looking for the **probability** of each outcome, here is the breakdown:

| Number of Heads | Possible Combinations | Probability |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **0** | TTT | 1/8 (12.5%) |
| **1** | HTT, THT, TTH | 3/8 (37.5%) |
| **2** | HHT, HTH, THH | 3/8 (37.5%) |
| **3** | HHH | 1/8 (12.5%) |
